findings.summary: Passage rendering drops the original per-sentence controls and explicit highlighted-sentence markers even when highlighted data is present.
findings.fix: Render sentences as individually labelled native controls or equivalent navigable items and expose highlighted status in visible text/programmatic names. Preserve paragraph reading and underline controls alongside sentence selection.
findings.evidence: A synthetic passage with one highlighted sentence rendered only plain combined text and three paragraph-level buttons, with zero highlight markers. Original web/app.js:946 renders sentence buttons and an explicit “강조” marker.

passed: Fresh source inspection confirms bounded lecturer-to-AI sequencing with cancellation fences, advertisement/unknown-duration handling, origin tracking and stop controls.
Review includes summary, key-segment descriptions, visual-only information, highlighted review entries and study-guide material; text remains available without connected video.

Verified student-local media and guardian preview media generate WebVTT caption tracks from timed transcript segments. Missing identity/timed caption data is disclosed; caption accuracy was not evaluated.
Guardian preview exposes transcript, safe descriptions, concepts, review categories, study guide, reasons, explicit file-delivery instructions and consented questions.

Current-screen description still selects a nearest prepared safe gap; the original implemented the same behavior. The extension announces the prepared timestamp rather than claiming fresh-frame analysis.
Native player controls and separate student playback/stop/volume/mute/caption controls are present; original files are selected locally and student storage is opt-in and account/lecture scoped.
notes: Fresh 0.4.2 audit on 2026-11-13. The highlighted-passage result was observed in an actual temporary-profile extension DOM probe; no real audio, AT or provider behavior was tested.

F44 reproduction: supply a snapshot passage with at least one sentence highlighted=true, open it in the student extension, and inspect the passage. Highlight identity and individual sentence controls are absent. Probe evidence is runtime-forms-media/probe-results.json.

F16 remains a simpler dashboard: lists and next-step text exist, while the original detailed status/dashboard experience remains partial. F23 still reports coarse queued/running/completed/failed/interrupted states without provider internal stages; neither limitation is counted as a new WCAG violation here.
F34 remains conditional: source-tab control requires a compatible standard HTML video and rejects DRM; actual YouTube/target-site compatibility was not independently tested by this specialist.
F36 remains explicit manual original-file delivery. Hash/size metadata and prepared materials are shared; automatic transfer between independent extension origins is not implemented.

The generic harness success list includes historical phase labels; only the explicitly described custom probes and baseline harness assertions were executed here. No inference of full media/learning parity should be made from that list.
